title: UXP Arrives in Premiere: A New Era for Plugin Development
summary: We’re thrilled to announce that the Unified Extensibility Platform (UXP) has officially graduated from beta and is now available in Adobe Premiere 25.6!
body_markdown: We’re thrilled to announce that the Unified Extensibility Platform (UXP) has officially graduated from beta and is now available in Adobe Premiere 25.6!
